content.title: About
content.content: Mashed potato ready‑to‑heat with gravy is a pre‑cooked mash made from selected potatoes, blended with a smooth gravy. It is sealed in an airtight package, retains its aroma and flavor, and can be heated in just a few minutes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mash is made from whole potatoes without artificial colourings.
The gravy typically contains natural broth, cream and spices, giving the dish a richer taste.
Flash‑freezing technology preserves up to 95 % of the vitamins and minerals found in fresh potatoes.
The product is widely used in cafeterias, hotels and homes as a quick side dish.
Ready‑to‑heat mashed potatoes appeared in Russia in the 1990s and have become a staple for busy consumers.

items.title: Rich source of potassium
items.content: Potatoes are high in potassium, which supports normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Despite heat processing, the mash retains some vitamin C, important for the immune system.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates for energy
items.content: Complex carbs provide a steady release of energy.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: When paired with a low‑fat gravy, the dish can fit into a low‑fat diet.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: A modest amount of fiber aids digestion.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ready‑made mash often contains added salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Allergens in gravy
items.content: The gravy may contain dairy or gluten; always check the label if you have sensitivities.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some versions include preservatives that could trigger reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Overheating
items.content: Overheating can make the mash dry and diminish its flavor.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the mash in the microwave or on the stovetop, stirring until smooth. Serve as a side with meat, fish or vegetable dishes. For extra flavor, add butter, cheese or fresh herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package in the freezer for up to 6 months. Once opened, store in the refrigerator and consume within 3‑4 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
